items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Who's that? ... [INTERVIEWER] Singleton Palmer -- tuba player. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He might have come a little later.

ctx.x: But you see, that didn't bother me -- that was triple tongue time you see -- di-di-di-di -- That's the way I played that you see, and that got him. I played triple tongue time, so --
Was Singleton Palmer around in those days?
